articles.summary: The AeroFlexx Pak is now the first all-in-one liquid packaging solution to earn the Arthritis Foundation's Ease of Use® Certification, proving accessibility, sustainability, and performance can live in one format.
articles.title: A New Standard for Liquid Packaging: AeroFlexx Earns Arthritis Foundation Ease of Use® Certification

articles.summary: Ascent Capital Partners has amended its Schedule 13D filing to express support for Innventure, Inc. (NASDAQ: INV), its leadership, and strategic direction. CEO Bill Haskell welcomes Ascent's confidence in the Company's strategy and commitment to delivering long-term shareholder value.
articles.title: Innventure, Inc. (NASDAQ: INV) announces that Ascent Capital Partners has amended its Schedule 13D filing to include a letter expressing support for Innventure, its leadership, and its strategic direction.

articles.summary: Innventure (NASDAQ: INV) will release Q1 2026 results after market close on May 14, with a live webcast at 5:00 pm ET.
articles.title: Innventure to Announce Q1 2026 Results on May 14
